name: Sprite
summary: A tiny fey archer that can see into hearts and turn invisible.

actions.name: Enchanting Bow
actions.onHit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the {ref:condition/charmed} condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

actions.name: Heart Sight

save.targets: one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save)

actions.onFailure: The sprite knows the target's emotions and alignment.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.text: The sprite casts *{ref:spell/invisibility}* on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
